subject.name: Religious Education
subject.description: Religious Education syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: 1.5 COMPETITION, CO-OPERATION AND TRUST
topics.description: Competition, cooperation and trust are part and parcel of society, helping individuals and groups work together for social development. This topic provides an overview of the important values, attitudes, and skills developed through competition, co-operation, and trust.

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC 1.5.1 COMPETITION AND CO-OPERATION
sub_topics.description: Explores the importance of competition, co-operation, and collaboration in society, as well as their advantages and disadvantages.

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of the importance of Competition and Co-operation in society
Promote collaboration in competition and co-operation

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC 1.5.2 TRUST
sub_topics.description: Focuses on justifying the importance of trust in everyday life, explaining how trust can be created, demonstrated, maintained, and its role in competition and co-operation.

competencies.description: Justify importance of Trust in real life

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC: 1.5.3 RELIGIOUS TEACHINGS ON COMPETITION, CO-OPERATION AND TRUST
sub_topics.description: Explores, examines, and evaluates teachings on competition, co-operation, and trust from Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, and Zambian Traditional Religion, and how they apply to modern society.

competencies.description: Apply religious teachings on competition, co-operation and trust in society

topics.name: 1.6 LEARNING AND TRUTH
topics.description: Learning is a lifelong process of acquiring new knowledge, skills, attitudes, and behaviours, while truth refers to being in accord with fact or reality. Learning and truth are closely intertwined concepts, with truth serving as the ultimate goal of learning.

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC 1.6.1 LEARNING
sub_topics.description: Explores guided and unguided types of learning experiences at home and school, analyzing their respective advantages and disadvantages.

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC 1.6.2 TRUTH
sub_topics.description: Explores the concept of truth, different ways statements can be true, distinctions among facts, opinions, and beliefs, and how social media can be used to justify truth.

competencies.description: Explore use of social media to justify truth

sub_topics.name: SUB-TOPIC: 1.6.3 RELIGIOUS TEACHINGS ON LEARNING AND TRUTH
sub_topics.description: Analyses religious teachings on learning and truth from Christianity, Zambian Traditional Religion, Islam, and Hinduism.

competencies.description: Analyse religious teaching on learning and truth
